verdict.rationale: WezTerm is a scriptable, Lua-configured terminal emulator and multiplexer, so built-in timed or recurring task execution is a plausible axis. However, the evidence documents no scheduling, timer or recurring-job capability. The `wezterm cli` subcommand can spawn programs and manipulate panes, but that is only a building block an external scheduler would have to drive, so it earns no credit.
